method: Native accessibility and screenshots through CUA on an isolated re-signed copy of the final Release app

observed.new_layout: guest send-danmaku tile directly beneath right-side chat; gift, bag and fan-club/badge icon actions beneath video
observed.gift_action: opened catalog drawer with room and anchor; guest login prompt; no purchase
observed.bag_action: opened bag view with guest login prompt
observed.fan_action: opened fan-club/badge view with unknown state shown as unknown rather than absent
observed.SC_to_chat_switch: guest send-danmaku tile disappeared on SC tab and returned beneath chat on Chat tab
observed.fullscreen: video and gift, bag, fan icons visible in bottom action bar

not_run: authenticated inline text editing, IME, emoji, @ mention and live send
real gift, bag send, fan join, badge light or other account mutation
narrow-window breakpoint and mobile device layouts
audio level, player instance count, stream re-request count and long-duration stability
SC delete/expiry and forced network outage
Intel hardware, macOS 13 hardware and other platforms
